items.title: Costco (COST) Is Running A Florida Distribution Center Fully Off The Grid
items.summary: Costco Wholesale has begun operating its Port St. Lucie, Florida distribution center fully off the power grid. The facility now runs on an on-site solar and battery energy system in partnership with Trinity Energy. This move aligns the site with Costco's broader net zero and sustainability objectives. Costco Wholesale, ticker NasdaqGS:COST, is adding a new dimension to its investment story with this off grid distribution center in Florida. The stock closed at $951.58, with a return of 11.4%...
